notes:
Controls: Default can't be changed any more. Tap + New layout to make your own (it starts like Default), give it a name, edit it, then Equip it. Every game uses the equipped buttons; Library ⋮ › Controls can pick other ones for one game.
Windows games: the side menu has On-screen buttons to hide or show them.
Updates: EdRoid asks to update when it opens, and Update downloads and installs the new version.
